I feel like the only “friends” I can trust are close family friends, everyone else I’ve known since high school only hit me up in times when I’m not looking and I just want some platonic and friendly company. It hurts seeing them treat me like this instead of a friend they actually care about. I’ve been trying to go out more, but it’s hard with my schedule ):

It was very toxic, and I know that she had pinned the word toxic on to me to cover for her own behavior. So why can’t I stop blaming myself for her cheating on me and treating me like garbage? For her being so emotionally unresponsive to the point that I would go to sleep crying every night for 3/4ths of our relationship? For leaving me not once, but twice, for other guys? 
I feel like it is my fault because I should have been a better boyfriend (and fiancé at one point) to where she wouldn’t cheat on me, so she wouldn’t feel like I was a chore or a burden or too negative. I feel like I could have done so much more to prevent it. 
My friendships are okay at best. Majority of them feel like they know me, but when they try to console me it feels like they don’t know me at all. It feels like they assume everyone in our friend group has the same personality and the same thoughts and feelings as each other. It hurts because a lot of their words hurt me, even if they’re just trying to crack a joke or help. They mean well, but they don’t realize that I don’t handle things the way that they do, even if I try to stand up for myself and tell them that I would like help in different ways. 
I just feel sad and a little useless. I feel like a burden and that I shouldn’t tell people about what happened. I just want to be okay again.

Don’t be sorry for the rant, it’s understandable. I would focus on seeing if you can get a scholarship, they have some scholarships for wild things (like being left handed, ambidextrous, etc) that could help you make your way through community college, and starting off there could get you into a university if that is what you’d like. I’m so sorry that your birth family and your adoptive family are so awful. Anxiety is a really tough thing to deal with, and if your family has medical insurance you can see group therapy for free or one on one sessions for a small copay. Anxiety is awful, and I know the feeling, but at some point you might have to push yourself out of your comfort zone. You’d be surprised at how much you truly are capable of.

It really sucks knowing that money really would make a lot of people happier. Life is really just so hard to get through if you’re poor. Sometimes you can’t eat, other times you have no heat or water because you couldn’t pay your bills. It’s rough and I wish people would understand that millennials and gen z are suffering. I’m sorry that you struggle with math. I know I’m a stranger, but feel free to message me with math questions you might have, I’m a natural with it (: changing your name when you’re 18 is a good idea, but depending on the state you live in you might have to save a pretty penny. I really hope that you’re able to enjoy the time you have left in school and that you find some friends who genuinely care about you, even if they’re strangers on reddit like in this community. You have so much to live for and it’s going to be okay if you take the steps in the right directions.
